reason: In our house the water is the bigger problem, not the light. Some days the tap gives nothing, so we wash by hand with the water we store, and a machine that keeps going when the power goes still needs water I don't have. And ₹22,000 is more than a month of what we earn.
objection: Water does not come every day, so even a machine with a battery will sit there. ₹1,999 a month for a year is too heavy for us, and in a bad harvest month I could not pay the EMI.
would_change_my_mind: A big Diwali or harvest-season offer, something like ₹14,000 with a free gift and a low EMI, plus proof from a neighbour that it works with the little water we store in a drum or bucket.
